scenes.title: Trap charge inside a flash cell
Organize cells into pages and blocks

vo.text: An SSD still remembers your files.
vo.speak: An SSD still remembers your files.

vo.text: Inside each flash cell, a special region can trap electrical charge.
vo.speak: Inside each flash cell, a special region can trap electrical charge.

vo.text: The amount of charge changes the cell's threshold voltage.
vo.speak: The amount of charge changes the cell's threshold voltage.

vo.text: To read it, the controller applies a test voltage and checks whether the cell conducts.
vo.speak: To read it, the controller applies a test voltage and checks whether the cell conducts.

vo.text: That response reveals the stored value.
vo.speak: That response reveals the stored value.

vo.text: Billions of cells are organized into pages and blocks.
vo.speak: Billions of cells are organized into pages and blocks.

vo.text: Writing gradually wears the insulating material that holds the charge.
vo.speak: Writing gradually wears the insulating material that holds the charge.

vo.text: So the controller spreads new writes across different cells, a process called wear leveling.
vo.speak: So the controller spreads new writes across different cells, a process called wear leveling.

vo.text: Trapped charge preserves the data, while careful reading and wear leveling keep the SSD useful.
vo.speak: Trapped charge preserves the data, while careful reading and wear leveling keep the SSD useful.
